MARA: Third burnt batch this week.
JOE: The wedding order is at noon. Two hundred rolls.
MARA: Then I will stand here and watch every loaf myself.
JOE: You fell asleep standing up yesterday.
MARA: I was resting my eyes on the dough.
JOE: The bride's mother is already in the shop.
MARA: Fine. Put Tickle on the counter where I can glare at it.
JOE: It says the second tray is ready.
MARA: It is never right. It is right. The rolls are golden.
JOE: Two hundred golden rolls, and you slept for an hour.
MARA: Nobody tells the bride's mother about the app.
